episode_summary: This episode of Keeping It Real introduces a new segment called 'Breakthrough with Michael,' where real estate coach Mike Opid will provide live coaching to agents feeling stuck in their careers. The episode emphasizes the importance of mentorship and honest conversations in overcoming career stagnation. Additionally, it highlights tools like Corded.io for effective agent recruitment and retention.
